framework: RIA-lite issue-based investor diligence; not government RIA, not litigation predictions
method: For each sector, discuss objectives, legal route, policy alternatives, distributional effects, evidence gaps, quantitative indicators that could be validated. No automatic financial-loss figures are asserted.

electricity_grid.thesis: Menilai pembangunan transmisi, gardu induk, penyediaan listrik PLN/PLN Batam, dan kebutuhan beban industri baru tanpa mengubah target RUPTL menjadi kapasitas tersedia.
chain: Legal authority: UU 30/2009, PP 14/2012, PP 25/2021
OSS dan IUPTL/PB-UMKU sesuai KBLI dan kegiatan
Kesesuaian lahan, hak tanah, AMDAL/UKL-UPL dan izin lintasan
Studi sistem PLN/PLN Batam: N-1, kapasitas trafo, proteksi
Pengadaan, konstruksi, SLO, commissioning dan COD
Tarif/kontrak listrik, standar mutu layanan, SAIDI/SAIFI
policy_options: No action
Menunggu jaringan eksisting
Risiko keterlambatan sambungan dan biaya operasional pelanggan meningkat jika kapasitas tidak cukup.
Targeted reinforcement
Gardu induk, feeder dan koneksi N-1 untuk klaster prioritas
Pilihan investasi lebih spesifik, tetapi membutuhkan studi biaya/manfaat lokasi dan komitmen pelanggan.
Integrated grid + flexibility
Substation + BESS + demand response + clean PPA
Dapat meningkatkan ketahanan dan fleksibilitas; wajib uji durasi penyimpanan dan ekonomi dispatch.
indicators: Signed industrial connection MW and queue
Realized capex / signed procurement / PLN Batam grid plan
electricity_grid.sector_note: Grid stress tidak dapat dihitung hanya dari kapasitas terpasang MVA, beban puncak regional, atau MW pembangunan nasional.

renewables.thesis: Menguji bankabilitas PPA, pengadaan, jaringan, izin lingkungan, hak lahan, pembiayaan dan kepastian COD PLTS/PLTA/PLTP/PLTB.
chain: Identifikasi basis RUPTL dan kondisi pengadaan
Pemeriksaan lokasi, keperluan tanah, AMDAL
Grid access, curtailment dan power balance
Pemenuhan standar PPA Permen ESDM 5/2025
Penutupan pendanaan/EPC/performance guarantee
Construction COD dan monitoring output tahunan
policy_options: No adjustment
PPA dan network baseline
Stranded time risk bila tarif, pembangkit, dan koneksi tidak sinkron.
Bankable PPA standardization
Pembagian risiko change-in-law, keterlambatan dan force majeure
Membantu pembiayaan jika konsisten dengan peraturan dan kemampuan pembayaran.
Co-planned grid + VRE storage
Koneksi tenaga surya/angin dan kapasitas fleksibilitas
Mengurangi curtailment potensial, tetapi tidak menggantikan studi energi dan biaya.
indicators: Signed PPA MW and specific COD
renewables.sector_note: RUPTL 69.512 MW termasuk storage dan fosil; target adalah rencana, bukan PPA ditandatangani atau MW beroperasi.

power_dc.thesis: Memastikan data center dapat benar-benar memperoleh daya IT yang aman dan legal sambil mematuhi lingkungan, tata ruang, privasi dan keamanan operasional.
chain: Saring announced MW: IT load atau facility power?
KBLI, NIB, KKPR/RDTR, AMDAL serta hak atas lokasi
Power contract & N-1 grid study; trafo/GI dedicated
PUE, cooling, water, fuel backup, onsite storage
Finance close, construction, GPU procurement, commissioning
PDP, cyber, cloud contracts, service quality
policy_options: No coordination
Beban baru masuk perizinan terpisah
Bisa terjadi mismatch target AI dan jadwal penyambungan PLN.
Cluster connection readiness
Satu cross-agency evidence pack per kampus
Meningkatkan transparansi kepada investor tanpa menjanjikan headroom yang tak diketahui.
Conditional incentive
Tax/land/grid incentives only on verifiable skills, energy, compute milestones
Menghindari valuasi berdasarkan rencana semata; detail insentif harus konsisten hukum.
indicators: Verified IT MW, facility MW and power contract
power_dc.sector_note: GPU count, grid power, permit, cloud service investment dan PPA tidak boleh dijumlahkan sebagai MW IT aktual.

minerba.thesis: Menguji izin pertambangan, hilirisasi mineral, perizinan industri, rantai pasok energi, akses ekspor, risiko WTO dan pembiayaan manufaktur.
chain: IUP/IUPK, RKAB dan sumber bahan baku sah
Izin dan standar industri/KBLI, tata ruang
AMDAL dan izin air/limbah/tailing
Grid/PLTU captive dan sumber BBM/energi
Kontrak EPC/finance, pabrik COD, produksi aktual
Ketentuan ekspor/penjualan dan risiko GATT/TRIMs/SCM
policy_options: Status quo
Implementasi hilirisasi berbasis aturan yang berlaku
Risiko regulasi dan litigasi dagang tetap tergantung komoditas dan instrumen.
Rule-by-rule compliance audit
Audit per HS code, perizinan, ketentuan ekspor dan pengecualian WTO
Mengurangi generalisasi larangan; tidak otomatis mengubah sengketa.
Diversified market and energy
Kontrak off-take, listrik bersih dan traceability
Dapat mengurangi paparan akses pasar dan biaya karbon, tergantung bukti proyek.
indicators: Actual ore processed, product and utilization
WTO DS592 and new trade remedies
minerba.sector_note: WTO DS592 adalah sengketa antarnegara. Putusan panel yang sedang dibandingi tidak otomatis membatalkan peraturan Indonesia.

coal_power.thesis: Menghubungkan DMO, pembangkit berbasis batubara, pengadaan PLN, logistik, polusi, transisi energi dan kewajiban lingkungan.
chain: Izin tambang dan RKAB
Ketentuan DMO dan kontrak pasokan PLTU
Transportasi dan port readiness
Kontrak batubara, kualitas dan inventory
AMDAL, abu, emisi dan penanganan limbah
Evaluasi penuaan PLTU vs RUPTL energi bersih
policy_options: Business as usual
DMO dan dispatch termal tradisional
Risiko ketergantungan kualitas/ketersediaan logistik dan pembiayaan emisi.
Resilience fuel chain
Inventaris dan logistik berlapis sesuai kebutuhan sistem
Dapat meningkatkan keamanan pasokan dengan biaya penyimpanan tambahan.
Managed transition
Skenario pensiun pembangkit dan penggantian kapasitas nyata
Perlu model cadangan, VRE+BESS, tenaga kerja dan dampak daerah.
indicators: PLTU outage hours and capacity factor
coal_power.sector_note: Tambahan MW pembangkit masa depan, energi listrik GWh, dan stok batubara harus dinilai sebagai satuan berbeda.

oilgas.thesis: Menilai aturan kontrak migas, aset PSC, pasokan gas ke pembangkit, kebijakan harga, izin infrastruktur dan arbitrase kontraktual.
chain: Working-area allocation/PSC contract and approvals
Plan of development, drilling and production permits
Gas pricing and supply allocations
Transport pipelines, LNG/FSRU and customer utility contracts
Environment, methane/leak and site permits
Production surveillance and dispute-resolution clause
policy_options: No coordination
Separate upstream/downstream gas planning
Term mismatch between gas delivery and capacity demand may persist.
Integrated gas-power contracting
Align upstream delivery, transport and grid dispatch
Reduces timing exposure if contract and infrastructure are verified.
Investment stability package
Regulatory clarity and contract/change-in-law review
Could aid financing; BIT/ICSID eligibility still treaty- and consent-dependent.
indicators: Arbitration clause and foreign investor nationality
oilgas.sector_note: HGBT, harga domestik, kontrak PSC dan pipeline/commercial agreements adalah instrumen berbeda.

carbon.thesis: Menguji pasar karbon, kepatuhan MRV, izin CCS/CCUS, pembagian risiko penyimpanan, kredibilitas offset dan kaitannya dengan Paris Agreement.
chain: Carbon/methane accounting boundary and activity eligibility
Environment and underground-storage permitting
Mekanisme MRV, registri, ownership attribute
Injection/transport monitoring and long-term liability
Credit issuance transfer rules and buyer
Audit, double-counting and Paris/NDC alignment
policy_options: No reform
Follow project approvals and available credits
Revenue, registry and ownership risks stay deal-specific.
Robust MRV
Uniform baseline, additionality and oversight
Reduces information asymmetry but adds compliance cost.
Risk-sharing for storage
Escrow, post-closure monitoring and liability allocation
May support projects if legally valid and financed.
carbon.sector_note: Paris Agreement adalah treaty state obligations; NDC bukan izin emisi atau kredit karbon otomatis.

wto_trade.thesis: Memetakan risiko sengketa ekspor bahan mentah, GATT XI, SCM/TRIMs, perubahan instrumen Kemendag dan konsekuensi bagi investasi hilirisasi.
chain: Identify domestic legal trade measure, HS code and dates
Analyze GATT XI and exceptions
SCM/TRIMs subsidy or local-content test
Track dispute procedural status panel vs appeal vs adopted ruling
Separate negotiated settlement from domestic implementing changes
Stress-test off-take, finance and market access
policy_options: Unchanged measures
Existing export restrictions continue
Continued treaty challenge risk; financial effect case-specific.
Targeted legally reviewed alternatives
Specific licensing/regulatory instruments aligned with trade objectives
Could meet public policy aims with different trade restrictiveness subject to legal analysis.
Negotiated resolution / diversification
Multilateral consultations and market diversification
May reduce exposure but timing and concessions are unknown.
indicators: New export laws by commodity and HS
wto_trade.sector_note: Panel findings and state-to-state appeal differ from investment-state awards; avoid calling DS592 final or repealing Indonesian law automatically.

investor_arbitration.thesis: Memisahkan forum komersial (BANI/SIAC/ICC), investor–state treaty (ICSID/UNCITRAL), dan penegakan putusan asing (Konvensi New York).
chain: Map investor ownership/nationality and treaty coverage
Check BIT/IIA ratification and sunset
Identify governing law, forum, seat and written consent
Assess notice/cooling-off/admissibility requirements
Review enforcement mechanism and assets
Separate public policy regulation from contractual default
policy_options: Contract ambiguity
Generic international arbitration clause
Higher jurisdiction/procedure uncertainty; no automatic investor-state treaty consent.
Precise dispute clause
Define governing law, forum, seat, notice and enforceability
Reduces drafting risk subject to local legal review.
Pre-dispute consultation & mediation
Contractual negotiation stage before arbitral escalation
Can limit friction if lawful and not waiver of applicable rights.
indicators: Treaty in force and covered investor nationality
investor_arbitration.sector_note: UNCITRAL model rules are contractual if adopted, ICSID consent is case-specific; Convention on Foreign Arbitral Awards governs recognition, not nationality or investment admission.
